correctness.rationale: For all n>=2, exact conditional triangle-increment moments follow from deterministic old edge number and the double-edge count. Deterministic conditional first moments imply martingale-difference orthogonality. Same-birth collision indicators annihilate triangle increments and off-birth covariances vanish by conditional means. Euler sum equals zeta(3). Rational sign checks t=3..31, H_31>4, and the 100-term zeta tail bound prove strict n>=4 underdispersion. The standalone independent exhaustive enumerator matches all five moments and cross-moments for every graph history through n=6 (14,400 histories at n=6, 153 assertions). The finite checks do not substitute for the analytic infinite proof.

value.rationale: The two smallest cycles are fundamental motifs in the same uniform-attachment DAG. Their previously known asymptotically independent Poisson approximation conceals a nonzero, explicitly negative order-one covariance and an exact all-finite-size underdispersion of three-cycles. This complete 2x2 second-cumulant calculation addresses a natural limitation of the published Poisson account, providing moment-sensitive information for sharper approximations and structural interpretation; it is not a routine recomputation of the already known mean.
